dogecoin.text: @JGPitts Im sure dogecoin early investors felt the same way. Many became millionaires and many sold off too early in fear. You don’t regret losing money, you regret not taking chances. You can always make more money elsewhere in theory, but opportunities aren’t always there.

@Salle7De It had to be at least 7.5 billion for me. Anything else is just selling yourself short. I held so much doge coin. A boat load and sold off everything at 7 cents. It’s all time highs 73 cents. Not gonna make that mistake again.
